downscroll_desc: If checked, notes scroll downward instead of upward.
rating_offset_desc: Adjusts the timing window (in milliseconds) for hitting a "Sick!" rating.
loading_style_desc: Sets the transition style between scenes.
rm_ms_offset_desc:
(In Development)
Removes the 'xx ms' display when hitting notes.
Potentially useful for specific mods.
scoretxt_bounce_desc:
(In Development)
Adds angular bounce effects to the score text when hitting notes.
scoretxt_style_desc:
(In Development)
Modifies the visual style of the score text.
iconbop_style_desc:
(In Development)
Customizes the bounce animation style for icons.
healthbar_style_desc:
(In Development)
Changes the visual appearance of the health bar.
change_language_desc:
Select display language
You need to restart the options menu after changing this setting.
single_splashanim_desc: use single arrow animation for note splash
showcase_style_desc:
(WIP)
Configure display styles in showcase mode
cpu_strums_desc: Enable hit effects for bot arrows
botplaytxt_style_desc: Modify visual effects for BOTPLAY text display
fpstxt_style_desc: Change font style for FPS counter
show_version_desc: Append current version information next to FPS counter
focus_game_desc: Pause game when window loses focus
show_exrating_desc:
Display extended rating graphics
File format example: sick-extra.png
Avoid enabling in pixel scenarios as implementation requires corresponding textures
rating_bounce_desc:
Enhance bounce animation for rating icons
Note: This option contains multiple known issues, recommended to keep disabled
exrating_bounce_desc:
Enhance bounce animation for extended rating icons
Note: Similarly contains various stability issues
rating_opac_desc: Adjust opacity level for rating textures (100% = original opacity)
rm_perfect_judge_desc:
Remove 'Perfect!' rating display
Affects extended rating textures accordingly
timebar_style_desc:
(Incomplete)
Modify timebar visual presentation in gameplay
